scope: Standalone publication tree with one initial commit.
checks: All files are allowlisted UTF-8 code, documentation, configuration, aggregate metrics or independently generated synthetic fixtures.
Credential patterns, literal secret assignments, private contact details, local paths, credential-store references and private endpoint patterns were scanned.
Synthetic panel was regenerated independently and compared byte for byte.
Original and adapted source files were checked against the archived experiment manifest and documented.
Git index bytes are checked against the inspected publication tree before upload.
Published files have a SHA-256 manifest; the remote tree is downloaded and compared after upload.
Current publication text and decoded Python literals were checked for untranslated Chinese prose; prompts and internal panel keys are English.
limitations: Pattern scans and review reduce accidental disclosure risk; they are not a mathematical guarantee. Dataset access remains governed by the original rights holders.
